events.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
events.summary: Inside the fire-gutted Heart O' The City Hotel, a four-officer squad kicks in the Room 303 door and the biggest cop forces Trinity to submit at gunpoint, so the arrest looks complete. Outside, Agents Smith, Brown, and Jones arrive and strip the operation from the Lieutenant, and Smith tells him his men are already dead. Back in the room, the moment the Big Cop reaches to cuff her, Trinity moves: she breaks the hold, dismantles the squad with inhuman speed, and is left the sole survivor standing over the dead cops.
events.action: Trinity goes from a cornered suspect complying with an arrest to the only one standing in a room full of dead cops, while the police operation that seemed to have her is revealed to have already failed.

events.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
events.summary: Morpheus tells Trinity her hardline is cut and Agents are in the building, so she abandons the hotel line and is redirected to a phone at Wells and Lake. She breaks past Agent Brown in the hall, climbs the fire escape when Smith blocks the alley, and crosses the rooftops with leaps the cops cannot match but that Brown duplicates. She dives through a window into a back stairwell, crashes down injured, finds no pursuer behind her, and reaches a street phone booth where she answers the ringing phone a moment before a garbage truck destroys the booth, which carries her out. The Agents never catch her, but the informant's tip gives them the crew's next target, and they set a machine search on the name Neo.
events.action: Enables Trinity's extraction while she is still a second ahead of the garbage truck, but hands the Agents the name of their next target, Neo; it costs Trinity a clean escape and leaves her battered, and it converts a failed capture into an active machine search.

events.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
events.summary: A cell phone delivered to Neo's cubicle connects him to Morpheus, who warns that the Agents are closing in and guides him through the office as a search closes in. Neo slips past the search into an empty office, where Morpheus directs him to open a window and cross a scaffold to the roof as the only exit. Neo refuses the climb, then attempts it, but the wind knocks him off balance, he drops the phone, and his nerve breaks. He climbs back inside just as a cop reaches the room, and is taken: the Agents lead him handcuffed out of the skyscraper and force him into a dark sedan, while Trinity witnesses the capture in her motorcycle's rearview mirror.
events.action: The event opens with Neo at his cubicle receiving a phone that rings with Morpheus on the line, warning that the Agents are coming and that he does not know what they will do. Neo glimpses Agent Smith, Agent Brown and [...] cops onto the floor, and a female employee points out his cubicle. Following Morpheus's commands, Neo lunges into an empty cubicle, hides while the Agents search his own, then rolls out, freezes behind a cop, and sneaks across the row into an empty office. There Morpheus directs him to open a window and cross a scaffold to the roof; Neo refuses, then relents and climbs onto the ledge, but a blast of wind knocks him off balance, he drops the phone, and he retreats inside just as a cop opens the door. The Agents then lead a handcuffed Neo out of the skyscraper and force him into a dark sedan, while Trinity watches the capture in her motorcycle's rearview mirror and reacts with dismay.

events.title: The Bug Removed
events.summary: In the moving car, Switch powers an extraction device over Neo's navel from the cigarette lighter while warning the burrowing bug is on the move and about to be lost; when suction fails, Trinity fires an electric charge into Neo that convulses the fluke-like bug free, and she lifts it in a glass cage before dumping it onto the pavement, where it reverts to a common wire tap. Neo, told the danger is himself and reminded of a road he already knows, sees the extracted bug and exclaims in shock at its reality. The car then vanishes into the rainy night and comes to rest in the deserted alley behind Hotel Lafayette.
events.action: Switch powers the extraction device from the cigarette lighter cable while the pressure gauge climbs and the ultrasound monitor shows the bug slithering beneath Neo's skin; he warns it is on the move and about to be lost. events.title: The Red Pill
events.summary: Trinity delivers Neo to Morpheus at Hotel Lafayette room 1313, having staked her judgment on him, then hands off to become his medical monitor as the crew's procedure turns into a race against his failing body. Morpheus converts Neo's nameless dread into a named enemy and an enslaving illusion no one can be told about, then offers the choice of two pills. Neo swallows the red pill, which is revealed to be a trace program to pinpoint his location. In the equipment room, Trinity fixes electrode disks to him while a cracked oval mirror heals into liquid, crawls up his body, and drives him into fibrillation and cardiac arrest just as Apoc secures the lock and Morpheus sends the signal that swallows Neo into darkness.
events.action: Trinity leads Neo to room 1313 and warns him to be honest because Morpheus knows more than he can imagine, then relinquishes the handoff. Morpheus receives Neo and reframes his hacker worship into a felt conviction that something is wrong with the world, defines the Matrix as an enslaving illusion no one can be told about, and offers the choice of two pills. Neo swallows the red pill. In the equipment room, Trinity fixes electrode disks to Neo while Morpheus explains the pill is a trace program to pinpoint his location; the cracked oval mirror heals into liquid, invades Neo's body, and triggers fibrillation and arrest. Apoc, after reporting still nothing under Morpheus's repeated prompting, secures the lock, and Morpheus orders Tank to send the signal, pulling Neo screaming into darkness.

prose_before_reconcile.summary: Trinity delivers Neo to Morpheus at Hotel Lafayette room 1313, then Morpheus converts Neo's lifelong nameless dread into a named enemy and an irreversible, self-chosen commitment before the crew's trace program unmans him physically. Neo swallows the red pill and is then wired into a chair where a cracking mirror liquefies, crawls up his body, and drives him into cardiac arrest just as the crew locks his location and Morpheus sends the signal that swallows him into darkness.
prose_before_reconcile.action: Trinity leads Neo to room 1313 and warns him to be honest because 'He is aware of far more than you could ever conceive.' Morpheus receives Neo in the adjacent room, reframes his hacker worship into a felt conviction that something is wrong with the world, defines the Matrix as an enslaving illusion no one can be told about, and offers the choice of two pills. Neo swallows the red pill. In the equipment room, Trinity fixes electrode disks to Neo while Morpheus explains the pill is a trace program to pinpoint his location; the cracked mirror heals into liquid, invades Neo's body, and triggers fibrillation and arrest. Apoc secures the lock and Morpheus orders Tank to send the signal, and Neo is pulled screaming into darkness.

events.title: Born Into the Real World
events.summary: Neo ruptures the gelatin shroud of his pod, stands bald and naked, and sees that he is one of countless humans farmed in pods before a machine disconnects the coaxial cable from his skull and sucks him and the magenta gelatin into a black hole. He is flushed through a waste line and sewer main, nearly drowning, before a metallic cable lifts him aboard a hovercraft, where Morpheus names him and welcomes him to the real world and he passes out.
events.action: Neo arches in agony as mercury runs from his nose, tears free of the magenta gelatin shroud, and stands bald and naked, breathing on his own. He looks out over endless rows of pods holding motionless human beings and recognizes himself as Neo, one of countless humans farmed in pods. A machine seizes him, opens the cable lock at the base of his skull, and the coaxial cable disengages, freeing him from the network. A vacuum then sucks him and the magenta gelatin into a black hole; he falls and slides through a waste line and sewer main, nearly drowning, before a metallic cable snatches him from the flow and lifts him aboard a hovercraft. A metal harness drops him half-conscious to the floor, and human hands help him up until he is looking at Morpheus, who smiles and welcomes him to the real world, and then Neo passes out.

prose_before_reconcile.summary: Neo tears free of his pod in a vast human power plant, is disconnected by a machine and sucked into a black hole, flushed through waste lines and a sewer main, then hauled aboard a hovercraft where Morpheus greets him by name before he blacks out.
prose_before_reconcile.action: Neo ruptures the gelatin shroud of his pod and stands, bald and naked, able to breathe for the first time. He finds a coaxial cable locked into the base of his skull and looks out over endless rows of pods holding motionless human beings, each a glowing petal on a tower spiraling to incomprehensible heights. A machine seizes him, opens the cable lock, slides a needle and cerebrum-chip from his skull, and a vacuum sucks him and the gelatin into a black hole. He falls and slides through a waste line, is flushed up through grease traps, and begins to drown in the sewer main before a metallic cable snatches him into a flying machine. Aboard a hovercraft, a metal harness drops him half-conscious to the deck; people lift him with their hands and arms until he is looking straight at Morpheus, who smiles and welcomes him to the real world, and then Neo passes out.
prose_before_reconcile.turns_on: The moment Neo is disconnected from the pod and sucked into the black hole—the machines release him instead of killing him, and that unexplained mercy is what carries him into the crew's hands.

events.title: Waking and Rebuilding
events.summary: Neo is carried from the rescue into a hovercraft infirmary where Dozer rebuilds his wasted body while Morpheus withholds explanation, then into his own recovery room where Morpheus replaces every answer with a single temporal blow—the year is near 2197—and leads him out to be shown the truth rather than told it.
events.action: Morpheus reports to Trinity that the search found 'him' and answers her 'I hope you're right' with certainty, then moves to steady the waking Neo with minimal, soothing facts while Dozer repairs his atrophied muscles and opens his unused eyes; once Neo is rebuilt and on his feet, Morpheus reframes his questions from 'what' to 'when,' delivers the loss of two centuries, admits only the year he cannot know, and converts teaching into a visual demonstration, leading Neo up the ladder toward the main deck.

state_triples.reading: Morpheus treats certainty as a discipline he imposes on the room: he corrects Trinity's 'hope' with 'know,' then repeats the same withholding toward Neo, doling out just enough truth to keep the body calm and deferring the rest. His gentleness and his refusal to explain are the same gesture—he is protecting a conviction he held before Neo could speak for himself, and steering a man he already believes is 'the one' toward a revelation he is confident will land.

Trinity refuses to let triumph close the moment, naming the risk that they may have gotten it wrong; her 'I hope you're right' is the counterweight Morpheus feels compelled to correct, and her staying off-page keeps her emotionally at a distance from the reverent framing he gives the rescue.

Neo's whole effort is to regain a foothold—first to know whether he has died, then to make the assault of needles and burning light make sense, then to understand what has been done to his body and where he is. Each answer Morpheus gives steadies him for a moment only to pull the ground further away, until the revelation that he has lost two centuries collapses his last assumption and leaves him willing to be led rather than to understand.
